key_insight: Fine-tuning a pretrained order-flow model enables competitive sub-second price forecasting; this paper concerns financial markets, not materials science.
engineering_relevance: The forecasts could support trade execution and market making rather than standalone directional trading.
method: Pretrain a 300M-parameter autoregressive model on Level-3 order-flow data from Bitstamp and Bitfinex.
Fine-tune it to predict microprice returns and realized volatility.
Evaluate return forecasts against classical baselines and test zero-shot transfer to unseen assets.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports better sub-second microprice-return prediction than classical baselines, including gradient boosting on handcrafted features, and zero-shot transfer to assets excluded from fine-tuning.
watch_item: Predicted price moves are smaller than the bid-ask spread plus fees, limiting direct trading profitability.
paper_title: Fine-Tuning an Order-Flow Foundation Model for Sub-Second Forecasting
